name: Create or reconstruct theoretical and fictional languages
description: Users requested the creation, reconstruction, or translation of theoretical, fictional, or hypothetical languages, often based on ancient archaeological cultures, constructed grammar rules, or speculative linguistic hypotheses. These requests involved generating vocabularies, grammatical structures, phonetic transcriptions, or translating specific texts into these non-existent or unverified systems.
